2025年普通高等学校招生全国统一考试英语听力 新课标Ⅱ卷
1. 平均语速：129词/分(2024年课标Ⅱ卷149词/分)。
2. 录音稿总词数：841词(2024年课标Ⅱ卷864词)。
3. 结构：22344(有变化)(2024年课标Ⅱ卷23334)。
4. 设题：事实细节题16题，推理判断题2题，观点态度题1题，主旨大意题1题。
5.难度：难度较2024年新高考卷约持平。

Text     132词  出行指路138词/分钟
W:Is this bus going to Baxley,sir?
M:No,I’m afraid not.See the yellow taxi on the corner?Turn left there to Madison Street and take Bus
No.4.
W:All  right,thank you!
1.How will the woman probably get to Baxley?
A.On  foot.
B.By  taxi.
C.By  bus.
解析：此题答案为C。考查考生获取事实性具体信息的能力。根据女士所说“Is this bus going to Baxley,sir?” (先生，这辆车是去巴克斯利的吗?)和男士所说 “See  the  yellow  taxi  on  the  corner?Turn  left  there  to   Madison Street and take Bus No.4.”  (看到街角的黄色出租车了吗?在那里左转到麦迪逊街，然后乘4路公
交车。)和女士的回答 “All  right,thank  you!”  (好的，谢谢!)可知，女士可能会乘坐公交车去Baxley。 故选C。
Text  227词  餐厅结账156词/分钟
W:So would you folks like some dessert?
M:Just bring us the bill,please.We need to get back on the road and continue our journey.
W:No  problem.
2.What is the man going to do?
A.Have some dessert.
B.Pay the bill.
C.Cancel the trip.
解析：此题答案为B。考查考生获取事实性具体信息的能力。根据男士所说 “Just bring us the bill,please.” (请把账单拿过来。)可知，男士打算结账。故选B。
Text     340词  购买电脑  156词/分钟
W:Dad,I can't afford that computer,but I think I really need it for my research.
M:Don't worry,Alice.Just pay as much as you can and I'll make up the rest.
W:Thank you.Then I can place the order.
重难点词汇：
重难点词汇：
make up  补足(某数量)
make up  补足(某数量)
熟词新义：
熟词新义：
place /plers/v.下指示；请求
3.What are the speakers talking about?
A.Buying a computer.
B.Doing  research.
C.Saving  money.
解析：此题答案为A。考查考生理解主旨与要义的能力。根据女士所说“Dad,I can't afford that computer,but I think I really need it for my research."  (爸爸，我买不起那台电脑，但我认为我确实需要它来做研究。) 和男士所说 “Don't worry,Alice.Just pay as much as you can and I'll make up the rest.”  (别担心，爱丽丝。 你能付多少就付多少，剩下的我来补。)以及女士的回答“Thank you.Then I can place the order. ”(谢谢 你!然后我就可以下订单了。)可知，说话者正在讨论购买电脑的事情。故选A。
Text     430词  学术交流119词/分钟
W:Hi,I’m Julie.I'm from the Department of Psychology.What about you?
M:I  study  Biology. I hope you can understand my English.I'm still learning.
W:Well,you  speak very clearly.
4.What is the man's major?
A.Psychology.
B.Biology.
C.English.
解析：此题答案为B。考查考生获取事实性具体信息的能力。根据男士所说 “I  study  Biology.”  (我学的是 生物学。)可知，男士的专业是生物学。故选B。
Text     534词  不小心损坏东西  124词/分钟
M:Linda,I need you to help me with my problem.
W:What did you do? Gee,you broke Mary's sports watch!
M:Ah,I wish I didn't touch it.
W:Well,don't   worry. We'll have it fixed.
5.What does Linda suggest?
A.Buying a sports watch.
B.Borrowing  Mary's  watch.
C.Getting the watch repaired.
解析：此题答案为 C 。考查考生获取事实性具体信息的能力。根据女士所说 “Gee,you  broke  Mary's  sports watch!”    (哎呀，你把玛丽的运动手表弄坏了!)和 “We'll  have  it   fixed.”   (我们会修好它的。)可知，
琳达建议修理手表。故选C。 其中选项中get sth.repaired是对原文 fix的同义转述。
Text     679 词  约会安排116词/分钟
W:Hello?
M:⑥⑦Hi,Delia,this  is  Peter.Are  you  doing  anything  Tuesday  evening?
W:Not  really.
M:⑥I've got two tickets for the National Theatre.Would you like to come?
W:Thanks.I'd  love  to.What's  on?
M:Stopper's  latest  play.
W:Oh,Sonny told me it was very good.
M:Yes,everyone  said   so.⑦Shall I meet you at your office at 6:00?Then we can go and have a quick snack.
The play starts at 7:00.
W:⑦ Sounds great. See you Tuesday then.
M:Good.Bye.
6.Why does Peter make the call?
A.To arrange a visit.
B.To extend an invitation.
C.To confirm an appointment.
解析：此题答案为B。考查考生获取事实性具体信息的能力。根据男士所说“Hi,Delia,this  is  Peter.Are  you doing anything Tuesday evening?”(你好，迪莉娅，我是彼得。星期二晚上你有事吗?)和“I’ve got two tickets for the National Theatre.Would you like to come?”  (我有两张国家剧院的票。你想来吗?)可知，男士打电 话是为了发出邀请。故选B。
7.Where will the speakers meet on Tuesday evening?
A.At the theatre.
B.At a snack bar.
C.At  Delia's  office.
解析：此题答案为C 。考查考生获取事实性具体信息的能力。根据男士所说 “ShallI meet you at your office at   6:00?”  (我6点在你的办公室见你好吗?)和女士所说 “Sounds   great.”   (听起来不错。)可知，说话 者们计划在Delia的办公室见面。故选C。
Text     7116词  学生使用智能手机的困扰  135词/分钟
W:Hi,Sam.How is your daughter doing at school?
M:⑧Well,since I bought a smartphone for Julia last summer,it seems the phone has become an extension of her arm.And it has made it impossible for her to concentrate.That really upsets me.
W:You are not alone in that.It is said that 95%of teenagers either own or have access to a smartphone.Somee schools have put in place policies,banning or controlling phone use during school hours.
M:⑨I’m all in favor of these policies.
W:Yeah,more and more schools have begun doing this.A friend of mine works at a school,and he told me that these policies had brought about positive changes.
重难点词汇：
重难点词汇：
extension       /k'stenfən/n. 延展
have access to    能够使用；能够接触
put in place    落实好：指采取措施或行动 in favor of    支持；赞同
bring about引起，导致
8.What does Sam say about his daughter?
A.She dislikes doing homework.
B.She overuses her smartphone.
C.She feels lonely at school.
解析：此题答案为B。考查考生获取事实性具体信息的能力。根据男士所说“Well,since I bought a smartphone for Julia last summer,it seems the phone has become an extension of her arm.And it has made it impossible for her  to  concentrate.”   (嗯，自从去年夏天我给朱莉娅买了一部智能手机以来，手机似乎就成了她手臂的延 伸。这让她无法集中注意力。)可知，山姆说他的女儿过度使用智能手机。故选B。
9.What is Sam's attitude towards the school policies?
A.Supportive.
B.Uncertain.
C.Disapproving.
解析：此题答案为A。考查考生理解说话者态度、观点和意图的能力。根据男士所说“I'm all in favor of these policies."    (我完全支持这些政策。)可知，山姆对学校的政策持支持态度。故选A。
Text      8125词  变更度假计划  138词/分钟
W:Max,are you ready to go?
M: ⑩Sure,honey.    Why are you dressed like that?I thought we were going to play table tennis with Billy and
Karen.
W:Oh,change  of  plan. ⑪Billy suggested we go rock climbing instead.
M:But I was really looking forward to playing table tennis.
W:We play table tennis allthe time.We'd like to go do some outdoor activities for a change,like rock climbing and horseback riding.
M:Oh,Jessie,I thought the point of this vacation was to relax.
W: ⑫Well,we  can  do   something  less  demanding  tomorrow.How  about  boating  on  the  lake?What  do  you think?
M:That'll be great.I like the idea of spending some time on the water.I'm sure Billy and Karen will like it,too.
重难点词汇：
重难点词汇：
rock climbing   攀岩horseback riding   骑马
rock climbing   攀岩
horseback riding   骑马
10.What is the probable relationship between the speakers?
A.Tourist and guide.
B.Husband and wife.
C.Trainer and trainee.
解析：此题答案为 B。考查考生对所听内容进行简单推理判断的能力。根据对话中的称呼 “honey”   以及对 话内容可推断出，两人是夫妻关系。故选B。
11.Who came up with the idea of going rock climbing?
A.Billy.
B.Karen.
C.Max.
解析：此题答案为A 。考查考生获取事实性具体信息的能力。根据女士所说 “Billy suggested we go rock climbing      instead."(Billy 建议我们去攀岩。)可知，是比利提出了去攀岩的想法。故选A。
12.What is Jessie's plan for tomorrow?
A.Going horseback riding.
B.Playing table tennis.
C.Rowing on the lake.
解析：此题答案为C。考查考生获取事实性具体信息的能力。根据女士所说“Well,we can do something less demanding tomorrow.How about boating on the lake?What do you think?”(明天我们可以做些轻松点的活动， 比如去湖上划船怎么样?你觉得怎么样?)可知，杰西计划明天去湖上划船。故选C。
Text 9(第16题为推断题)185词 工作机会与抉择139词/分钟
M: ⑬Hi,Susanna,I had an interview with Anderson HITECH and they offered me the position of sales manager. I want to let you know before I make my decision.
W:I’m sorry to hear that,Frank,but I appreciate you telling me before you accept the offer.
M:I really enjoy my work here.I put in effort for 5 years to gain more experience,⑭but there seems no hope of being promoted .
W:What would help you decide to stay?
M:I would consider staying if I could change my position.I would love working in this same department,but I would like to be doing something different.And they offered me 6%more than my present salary.
W:When do you have to tell them your decision?
M:They want me to respond by Friday.
W:Let me see.⑮I'lltalk to the human resources director and let you know the result on Thursday.Can you wait until then?
M:That'll be too late. ⑮Wednesday will be better.
W: ⑮OK,no   problem.I'm going to do everything I can to keep you on board.
M:I appreciate what you are doing for me.
熟词新义：
熟词新义：
position           /p'ziʃn/n. 职位；职务offer         /'pfə(r)/n. 提供(东西或机会)
position           /p'ziʃn/n. 职位；职务
offer         /'pfə(r)/n. 提供(东西或机会)
13.What did Frank do before coming to Susanna?
A.He went to a tech fair.
B.He signed a contract.
C.He had a job interview.
解析：此题答案为C。考查考生获取事实性具体信息的能力。根据男士所说“Hi,Susanna,I  had  an  interview
with Anderson HITECH and they offered me the position of sales manager."   (嗨，苏珊娜，我参加了安德森   HITECH 公司的面试，他们给了我销售经理的职位。)可知，弗兰克在来找苏珊娜之前参加了工作面试。
故选C。
14.What does Frank hope to get?
A.A  promotion.
B.A  vacation.
C.A  bonus.
解析：此题答案为A。考查考生获取事实性具体信息的能力。根据男士所说“but there seems no hope of being promoted." (但似乎没有晋升的希望。)可知，弗兰克希望得到晋升。故选A。
15.When will Frank know the result from his company?
A.Wednesday.
B.Thursday.
C.Friday.
解析：此题答案为A。考查考生获取事实性具体信息的能力。根据女士所说 “I'll talk to the human resources director and let you know the result on Thursday.Can you wait until then?”   (我会和人力资源总监谈谈，并在 周四告诉你结果。你能等那么久吗?)和男士所说 “Wednesday will be better.”  (周三会更好。)以及女  士的回答"OK,no    problem."  (好，没问题)可知，弗兰克将在周三得到公司的结果。故选A。
16.Who is Susanna?
A.Frank's   client.
B.Frank's   lawyer.
C.Frank's  boss.
解析：此题答案为C 。考查考生对所听内容进行简单推理判断的能力。根据对话内容，苏珊娜在公司内部 与弗兰克讨论工作事宜，并表示会与人力资源总监沟通，这表明她是弗兰克的上司。故选C。
Text 10    173 词  暑期夏令营介绍  110词/分钟
W:Hello  everyone.Welcome  to  Creative  Day   School.This   summer  we  provide  two   full-time   summer  camp programs.Both will last the entire time the children are out of school. ⑰Our first summer camp is for our four-year-0lds,called  Mini  Camp. This Mini Camp will sillhave their normal everyday schedule with a lot of fun activities.At least once a week,our mini campers will go on a field trip.These field trips could consist of a day at the beach or exploring the natural museum.  ⑱Our Older Summer Camp is provided for ages 5 through 12.There are scheduled summer fun activities and games.The children will participate in art,outdoor play,games and much more.Swimming at a nearby pool is often a weekly field trip for ages 6 and up. ⑱Other field trips could include bowling,a day at the movies or a picnic in the park.⑲Permission   of parents and activity fees are  required  to  participate  in  all  field  trips.2⑳Now  let's  watch  a  five-minute  film  about  last  year's programs.
重难点词汇：
重难点词汇：
field trip (常指学生)户外教学
field trip (常指学生)户外教学
permission /pə'mrfən/n.许可
permission /pə'mrfən/n.许可
17.Who is the Mini Camp intended for?
A.Four-year-olds.
B.Five-year-olds.
C.Six-year-olds.
解析：此题答案为A。考查考生获取事实性具体信息的能力。根据说话者所说 “Our first summer camp is for  our four-year-olds,called Mini Camp. ”(我们的第一个夏令营是为四岁的孩子准备的，叫做Mini  Camp。) 可 知 ，Mini Camp是为四岁的孩子设计的。故选A。
18.Which activity does the Older Summer Camp organize?
A.Museum  visits.
B.Bowling  games.
C.Family  gatherings.
解析：此题答案为B。考查考生获取事实性具体信息的能力。根据说话者所说 “Our Older Summer Camp is provided for ages 5 through 12.”(我们的年长夏令营是为5到12岁的孩子提供的。)和“Other field trips could include bowling,”(其他户外活动包括保龄球)可知， Older Summer Camp组织了保龄球活动。故选B。
19.What is a requirement for joining the field trips?
A.Camping  experience.
B.Parental  permission.
C.Swimming  skills.
解析：此题答案为 B。考查考生获取事实性具体信息的能力。根据说话者所说 “Permission of parents and     activity fees are required to participate in all field trips. ”(参加所有户外活动需要家长的许可和活动费用。) 可知，参加户外活动需要家长的许可。故选B。
20.What  will  the  speaker  do  next?
A.Collect    fees.
B.Answer      questions.
C.Show  a  short  video.
解析：此题答案为C。考查考生获取事实性具体信息的能力。根据说话者所说“Now  let's  watch  a  five-minute film   about   last   year's   programs."  (现在让我们观看一部关于去年项目的五分钟短片。)可知，说话者接下 来会播放一部短片。故选C。
